$comment: Public repositories at the commit before they upgraded express from >=4 <5 to >=5 <6, and every finding the pack must report there. Drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` (compiler + upgrade diff) and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the first score. See RESEARCH.md and docs/packs.md, "Ground truth".

repos.why: CLI, one package, npm. Upgrade 6414c142 renames the unnamed `*` route wildcards path-to-regexp 8 rejects (source and test servers, and route data of a mock API) and drops two test assertions on an empty `req.body`. The compiler reports nothing new. http-proxy-middleware 2 to 3 in the same commit is that package's own change and is not a site.

findings.note: `app.all('*', …)` becomes `'{*splat}'`
route data `path: 'blobs/*'`, registered by the mock API's `app[method](path)`, becomes `'blobs/{*splat}'`
an assertion that a GET request's body is `{}` is removed: without a parser `req.body` is undefined in Express 5
same assertion, second test
route data `'sites/*/service-instances'` becomes `'sites/:siteId/service-instances'`
route data `'sites/*'` becomes `'sites/{*splat}'`

repos.why: Server at the root, npm. Upgrade b25ee437 rewrites wildcard routes for path-to-regexp 8 (single routes and a list registered in a loop), replaces csurf (typed for Express 4) and moves body-parser and serve-static to 2.x with express.

findings.note: TS2345 `csrf(req, res, next)`: csurf's Request type (@types/express 4) no longer accepts Express 5's; the upgrade replaces csurf with csrf-sync
`router.all('/addAndroidRegistration*', …)` becomes `…{*path}`
`router.all('/addIosRegistration*', …)` becomes `…{*path}`
`router.all('/ws/*', …)` becomes `'/ws/{*path}'`
the `proxyPaths` list (681-684), registered by one `for…of` over `router.all(path, …)`: every `*` becomes `{*path}`, `/jquery.*` becomes `/jquery.:ext`
`createMiddleware` gains an explicit `RouteMiddleware` return type, "to resolve type portability issue with Express 5's bundled types" (commit message); not reported by a no-emit compile
